request.description: Approves sending the file. Needs the applicant's `lender_sharing` consent naming this lender and every required assessment and submission document of the product, already through the malware check (`documents_missing` when absent, `documents_not_ready` while still being checked). A worker (queue `submissions.deliver`) then builds the encrypted packet, locks the shared documents, moves the submission to `sent_to_lender`, the application to `submitted`, and notifies the lender's admins and credit officers. Optional `expectedVersion` guards against two people acting at once. Staff context (ops leads and reviewers act; compliance, support and credit read).
